narrative: Grid fault ride through event took MGX33-1644D-0331 offline at approximately 1340. The unit had cleared the fault and resynchronised on its own before I arrived on site. Verified output normal against the two neighbouring units, all three within about 1 percent of each other on the same irradiance. Pulled the event record from the unit: undervoltage on two phases lasting roughly 180 ms, which is consistent with a transmission side event rather than anything on the plant. No action required, nothing to fix.
